run_entropy_filtering: run the entropy-based question filtering tool to prune a question dataset using entropy and count thresholds
run_getStats: run getStats to load entropy and count data from JSON files in a directory into a master dictionary
run_getEnvWiseStats: run getEnvWiseStats to compute per-environment statistics on question acceptance rates before and after pruning
run_collapseType: run collapseType to map detailed question type labels into broader collapsed categories like exist or dist_compare
run_getListOfJsonFiles: run getListOfJsonFiles to find all JSON files in a given directory using a shell find command
